Shinylive loads the app directory as top-level modules. from charts import series_figure from labels import ( component_color_map, component_label, country_color_map, country_label, ) from scenario_engine import ( EA_GEO, GraphSeries, aggregate_scenarios, load_dashboard_data, scenario_components, selected_component_contributions, selected_country_contributions, selected_graph_series, selected_headline, ) DATA_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "data" DATA = load_dashboard_data(DATA_DIR) COUNTRY_CHOICES = { code: f"{country_label(code)} ({code})" for code in DATA.countries } GEO_CHOICES = { EA_GEO: "Euro area (EA)", **COUNTRY_CHOICES, } SERIES_CHOICES = { "HEADLINE": "Headline HICP", **{ code: f"{code} — {component_label(code)}" for code in DATA.coicops }, } COMPONENT_COLORS = component_color_map(list(DATA.coicops)) COUNTRY_COLORS = country_color_map(list(DATA.countries)) DEFAULT_SHOCK = 10.0 def _fmt_signed(value: float, digits: int = 2) -> str: return f"{value:+.{digits}f}" def _parse_shock_text(raw: str | None) -> tuple[float | None, str | None]: try: value = float(str(raw).strip()) except (TypeError, ValueError): return None, "Enter a number." if not math.isfinite(value): return None, "Enter a finite number." if value <= -100.0: return None, "Shock must be greater than -100%." return value, None def _fmt_input(value: float) -> str: return f"{value:g}" def _metrics_html(graph: GraphSeries) -> str: baseline_change = graph.baseline - graph.origin_index scenario_change = graph.scenario - graph.origin_index delta = graph.scenario - graph.baseline baseline_pct = 100.0 * (graph.baseline / graph.origin_index - 1.0) scenario_pct = 100.0 * (graph.scenario / graph.origin_index - 1.0) delta_pct = 100.0 * (graph.scenario / graph.baseline - 1.0) return f"""
Baseline change
{_fmt_signed(baseline_change)} pts
{_fmt_signed(baseline_pct)}% vs origin {DATA.origin:%Y-%m}
Shocked change
{_fmt_signed(scenario_change)} pts
{_fmt_signed(scenario_pct)}% vs origin {DATA.origin:%Y-%m}
Delta
{_fmt_signed(delta)} pts
{_fmt_signed(delta_pct)}% shocked vs baseline
""" def _segment_html( *, label: str, value: float, share: float, share_net: float | None, color: str, bottom: float, height: float, ) -> str: net_text = ( f", {share_net * 100:+.1f}% of net change" if share_net is not None else "" ) tooltip = f"{label}: {_fmt_signed(value)} index pts ({share:.1f}% of gross){net_text}" escaped_tooltip = html.escape(tooltip) return ( f'
' ) def _bar_html( frame: pd.DataFrame, *, label_column: str, label_fn, color_map: dict[str, str], title: str, total: float, total_pct: float, card_class: str, ) -> str: clean = frame.loc[frame["contribution"].abs() > 1e-12].copy() if clean.empty: return f"""
{html.escape(title)} 0.00 pts
No change above baseline.
""" clean = clean.sort_values("contribution", ascending=False) positive = clean[clean["contribution"] > 0].copy() negative = clean[clean["contribution"] < 0].copy() gross = float(clean["contribution"].abs().sum()) negative_abs_sum = float(negative["contribution"].abs().sum()) zero_position = 100.0 * negative_abs_sum / gross if gross else 0.0 segments = [] cumulative = 0.0 for _, row in positive.iterrows(): code = str(row[label_column]) height = 100.0 * float(row["contribution"]) / gross segments.append( _segment_html( label=label_fn(code), value=float(row["contribution"]), share=100.0 * abs(float(row["contribution"])) / gross, share_net=( float(row["share_net"]) if "share_net" in row.index else None ), color=color_map.get(code, "#95a5a6"), bottom=zero_position + cumulative, height=height, ) ) cumulative += height cumulative = 0.0 for _, row in negative.sort_values("contribution").iterrows(): code = str(row[label_column]) height = 100.0 * abs(float(row["contribution"])) / gross segments.append( _segment_html( label=label_fn(code), value=float(row["contribution"]), share=100.0 * abs(float(row["contribution"])) / gross, share_net=( float(row["share_net"]) if "share_net" in row.index else None ), color=color_map.get(code, "#95a5a6"), bottom=zero_position - cumulative - height, height=height, ) ) cumulative += height legend = [] for _, row in clean.sort_values( "contribution", key=lambda values: values.abs(), ascending=False ).iterrows(): code = str(row[label_column]) share_net = ( float(row["share_net"]) if "share_net" in row.index else None ) net_text = ( f"{share_net * 100:+.1f}% net" if share_net is not None else "" ) legend.append( f"""
{html.escape(label_fn(code))} = 0 else "neg")}"> {_fmt_signed(float(row["contribution"]))} {net_text}
""" ) zero_line = "" if 0.0 < zero_position < 100.0: zero_line = ( f'
' ) return f"""
{html.escape(title)} {_fmt_signed(total)} pts ({_fmt_signed(total_pct)}%)
{''.join(segments)} {zero_line}
{''.join(legend)}
""" uniform_shock = reactive.value(DEFAULT_SHOCK) shock_values = reactive.value( {country: 0.0 for country in DATA.countries} ) @reactive.calc def effective_shocks() -> dict[str, float]: if input.scope() == "uniform": value = float(uniform_shock()) return {country: value for country in DATA.countries} return dict(shock_values()) @reactive.calc def scenario() -> pd.DataFrame: return scenario_components(DATA, effective_shocks()) @reactive.calc def aggregation(): return aggregate_scenarios(DATA, scenario()) @reactive.calc def graph_series(): geo = input.geo() shocks = effective_shocks() shock_percent = ( float(shocks[geo]) if geo in DATA.countries else None ) return selected_graph_series( DATA, aggregation(), geo, input.series(), shock_percent, ) @reactive.effect @reactive.event(input.shock) def _store_shock_input() -> None: value, error = _parse_shock_text(input.shock()) if error is not None or value is None: return if input.scope() == "uniform": uniform_shock.set(value) return state = dict(shock_values()) state[input.shock_country()] = value shock_values.set(state) @reactive.effect @reactive.event(input.geo) def _sync_shock_country_with_geo() -> None: if input.scope() != "country": return geo = input.geo() if geo not in DATA.countries: return ui.update_select("shock_country", selected=geo) ui.update_text( "shock", value=_fmt_input(float(shock_values().get(geo, 0.0))), ) @reactive.effect @reactive.event(input.shock_country) def _sync_text_to_country() -> None: if input.scope() != "country": return country = input.shock_country() ui.update_text( "shock", value=_fmt_input(float(shock_values().get(country, 0.0))), ) @reactive.effect @reactive.event(input.scope) def _sync_text_to_scope() -> None: if value=_fmt_input(float(shock_values().get(country, 0.0))), ) @reactive.effect @reactive.event(input.apply_all) def _apply_to_all() -> None: value, error = _parse_shock_text(input.shock()) if error is @reactive.event(input.zero_all) def _zero_all() -> None: uniform_shock.set(0.0) shock_values.set({country: 0.0 for country in DATA.countries}) ui.update_text("shock", value="0") ui.page_opts( fillable=True, window_title="HICP shock simulator", ) ui.include_css(Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "www" / "styles.css") with ui.div(class_="app-shell"): with ui.div(class_="panel panel-left"): ui.h1("HICP shock simulator", class_="app-title") ui.div( "Modelling energy shock effects at a 3 month horizon", class_="app-subtitle", ) ui.h2("Controls", class_="section-title") ui.input_select( "geo", "Graph geography", choices=GEO_CHOICES, selected=EA_GEO, ) ui.input_radio_buttons( "scope", "Shock scope", choices={ "uniform": "Uniform across EA", "country": "By country", }, selected="uniform", ) with ui.panel_conditional("input.scope === 'country'"): ui.input_select( "shock_country", "Shock country", choices=COUNTRY_CHOICES, selected="FR", ) ui.div( "Country-specific mode starts from zero. Set a shock for " "the selected country, then switch countries as needed.", class_="muted small-note", ) ui.input_text( "shock", "Shock to latest CP045 + CP0722 index (%)", value=_fmt_input(DEFAULT_SHOCK), placeholder="e.g. 10", ) @render.ui def shock_error(): _, error = _parse_shock_text(input.shock()) if error is None: return ui.HTML("") return ui.div(error, class_="input-error") with ui.div(class_="button-row"): ui.input_action_button( "apply_all", "Apply current value to all", class_="btn-secondary btn-sm", ) ui.input_action_button( "zero_all", "Zero all shocks", class_="btn-secondary btn-sm", ) ui.input_action_button( "reset_all", "Reset all to +10%", class_="btn-secondary btn-sm", ) with ui.div(class_="panel panel-center"): with ui.div(class_="center-head"): ui.h2("Scenario graph", class_="section-title") ui.input_select( "series", "Series", choices=SERIES_CHOICES, selected="HEADLINE", ) @render.ui def graph_metrics(): return ui.HTML(_metrics_html(graph_series())) @render.plot(height=620) def graph_plot(): return series_figure(DATA, graph_series(), input.geo()) ui.div( ( "Scenario indices apply a percent shock to the latest " "CP045/CP0722 index, then propagate it through the " "direct-horizon coefficients. EA aggregates are built " "bottom-up with country and item weights." ), class_="method-note", ) with ui.div(class_="panel panel-right"): ui.h2("Contribution to the increase", class_="section-title") with ui.div(class_="bars-grid"): @render.ui def component_bar(): geo = input.geo() frame = selected_component_contributions(aggregation(), geo) total = selected_headline(aggregation(), geo) return ui.HTML( _bar_html( frame, label_column="coicop", label_fn=lambda code: ( f"{code} — {component_label(code)}" if component_label(code) != code else code ), color_map=COMPONENT_COLORS, title="By component", total=total["delta"], total_pct=total["pct_change"], card_class="component-card", ) ) @render.ui def country_bar(): geo = input.geo() frame = selected_country_contributions(aggregation(), geo) total = selected_headline(aggregation(), geo) return ui.HTML( _bar_html( frame, label_column="country", label_fn=lambda code: ( f"{country_label(code)} ({code})" if country_label(code) != code else code ), color_map=COUNTRY_COLORS, title="By country", total=total["delta"], total_pct=total["pct_change"], card_class="country-card", ) ) ui.div( ( "Bars show index-point contributions. Segment height is " "proportional to absolute contribution; negative " "contributions sit below the zero line." ), class_="method-note", )

"""Dark matplotlib figures for the HICP shock dashboard."""

from __future__ import annotations

import matplotlib.dates as mdates
from matplotlib.figure import Figure
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D

try:
    from .labels import component_label, country_label
    from .scenario_engine import DashboardData, GraphSeries
except ImportError:  # Shinylive loads the app directory as top-level modules.
    from labels import component_label, country_label
    from scenario_engine import DashboardData, GraphSeries

BG = "#0b1118"
AX_BG = "#0f1822"
TEXT = "#e6edf3"
MUTED = "#93a4b8"
GRID = "#263445"
HISTORY = "#60a5fa"
BASELINE = "#fbbf24"
SCENARIO = "#f87171"
ORIGIN = "#94a3b8"
SHOCKED = "#c084fc"


def _style_axes(ax, fig: Figure) -> None:
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(BG)
    ax.set_facecolor(AX_BG)
    for spine in ax.spines.values():
        spine.set_color(GRID)
    ax.tick_params(colors=MUTED, labelsize=9)
    ax.xaxis.label.set_color(TEXT)
    ax.yaxis.label.set_color(TEXT)
    ax.title.set_color(TEXT)
    ax.grid(color=GRID, alpha=0.55, linewidth=0.7)


def series_figure(
    data: DashboardData,
    series_data: GraphSeries,
    geo: str,
) -> Figure:
    """Render one headline or component series with baseline and scenario."""
    history = series_data.history
    target = data.target_period
    origin = data.origin

    if series_data.code == "HEADLINE":
        title = f"{country_label(geo)}: headline HICP index"
    else:
        title = (
            f"{country_label(geo)}: "
            f"{component_label(series_data.code)} "
            f"({series_data.code})"
        )

    fig = Figure(figsize=(9.2, 6.9), dpi=100)
    ax = fig.add_subplot(111)
    _style_axes(ax, fig)

    ax.plot(
        history["date"],
        history["index_value"],
        color=HISTORY,
        linewidth=1.9,
    )
    ax.axvline(
        origin,
        color=ORIGIN,
        linestyle=":",
        linewidth=1.0,
        alpha=0.9,
    )

    origin_value = series_data.origin_index
    ax.plot(
        [origin, target],
        [origin_value, series_data.baseline],
        color=BASELINE,
        linestyle="--",
        linewidth=1.0,
        alpha=0.65,
    )
    ax.plot(
        [origin, target],
        [origin_value, series_data.scenario],
        color=SCENARIO,
        linestyle="--",
        linewidth=1.0,
        alpha=0.65,
    )

    ax.scatter(
        [target],
        [series_data.baseline],
        color=BASELINE,
        edgecolor=BG,
        linewidth=0.7,
        s=70,
        zorder=4,
    )
    ax.scatter(
        [target],
        [series_data.scenario],
        color=SCENARIO,
        edgecolor=BG,
        linewidth=0.7,
        marker="*",
        s=180,
        zorder=5,
    )

    if (
        series_data.is_source
        and series_data.shock_percent is not None
        and geo != "EA"
    ):
        shocked_origin = origin_value * (
            1.0 + series_data.shock_percent / 100.0
        )
        ax.scatter(
            [origin],
            [origin_value],
            color=ORIGIN,
            edgecolor=BG,
            linewidth=0.6,
            s=36,
            zorder=4,
        )
        ax.scatter(
            [origin],
            [shocked_origin],
            color=SHOCKED,
            edgecolor=BG,
            linewidth=0.6,
            s=48,
            zorder=5,
        )

    ax.set_title(
        title,
        fontsize=14,
        fontweight="bold",
        loc="left",
        color=TEXT,
    )
    ax.set_ylabel("Index", color=TEXT)
    locator = mdates.MonthLocator(interval=6)
    ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(locator)
    ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.ConciseDateFormatter(locator))

    handles = [
        Line2D(
            [0],
            [0],
            color=HISTORY,
            linewidth=2,
            label="Historical index",
        ),
        Line2D(
            [0],
            [0],
            color=BASELINE,
            marker="o",
            linestyle="None",
            markersize=7,
            label=f"Conditional baseline t+3 ({target:%Y-%m})",
        ),
        Line2D(
            [0],
            [0],
            color=SCENARIO,
            marker="*",
            linestyle="None",
            markersize=11,
            label="Scenario",
        ),
    ]
    if (
        series_data.is_source
        and series_data.shock_percent is not None
        and geo != "EA"
    ):
        handles.append(
            Line2D(
                [0],
                [0],
                color=SHOCKED,
                marker="o",
                linestyle="None",
                markersize=6,
                label="Shocked origin index",
            )
        )

    ax.legend(
        handles=handles,
        loc="upper left",
        frameon=True,
        facecolor=AX_BG,
        edgecolor=GRID,
        labelcolor=TEXT,
        fontsize=8.5,
        ncol=1,
    )
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.09, right=0.98, top=0.90, bottom=0.13)
    return fig

"""Human-readable labels and stable colours for the dashboard."""

from __future__ import annotations

import matplotlib

COUNTRY_NAMES = {
    "AT": "Austria",
    "BE": "Belgium",
    "BG": "Bulgaria",
    "CY": "Cyprus",
    "DE": "Germany",
    "EE": "Estonia",
    "EL": "Greece",
    "ES": "Spain",
    "FI": "Finland",
    "FR": "France",
    "HR": "Croatia",
    "IE": "Ireland",
    "IT": "Italy",
    "LT": "Lithuania",
    "LU": "Luxembourg",
    "LV": "Latvia",
    "MT": "Malta",
    "NL": "Netherlands",
    "PT": "Portugal",
    "SI": "Slovenia",
    "SK": "Slovakia",
    "EA": "Euro area",
}

COMPONENT_NAMES = {
    "CP01": "Food & non-alcoholic beverages",
    "CP02": "Alcoholic beverages & tobacco",
    "CP03": "Clothing & footwear",
    "CP045": "Electricity, gas & other fuels",
    "CP04_CORE": "Housing & utilities excl. energy",
    "CP05": "Furnishings & household equipment",
    "CP06": "Health",
    "CP0722": "Fuels & lubricants for transport",
    "CP07_CORE": "Transport excl. fuels",
    "CP08": "Communications",
    "CP09": "Recreation & culture",
    "CP10": "Education",
    "CP11": "Restaurants & hotels",
    "CP12": "Miscellaneous goods & services",
    "CP13": "Personal care & social protection",
}

_QUALITATIVE = [
    matplotlib.colors.to_hex(color)
    for color in matplotlib.colormaps["tab20"].colors
]
_QUALITATIVE_EXTRA = [
    matplotlib.colors.to_hex(color)
    for color in matplotlib.colormaps["tab20b"].colors
]
_ALL_COLORS = [*_QUALITATIVE, *_QUALITATIVE_EXTRA, "#34495e", "#7f8c8d"]


def country_label(code: str) -> str:
    return COUNTRY_NAMES.get(code, code)


def component_label(code: str) -> str:
    return COMPONENT_NAMES.get(code, code)


def country_color_map(codes: list[str]) -> dict[str, str]:
    return {
        code: _ALL_COLORS[index % len(_ALL_COLORS)]
        for index, code in enumerate(codes)
    }


def component_color_map(codes: list[str]) -> dict[str, str]:
    return {
        code: _ALL_COLORS[index % len(_ALL_COLORS)]
        for index, code in enumerate(codes)
    }

name: scenario_engine.py
content:
"""Scenario and EA aggregation engine for the dashboard.

The dashboard shock is a percent change to the latest origin index of CP045
and CP0722. A shock of ``s = log(1 + percent / 100)`` raises both the origin
YoY rate and its 1-month change by ``s``. Target components receive the
fitted ``ds`` pass-through. Shock sources also receive the direct ``s`` level
shift because their target-period YoY forecast is reconstructed as
``y_origin + delta``. All EA and country aggregates are bottom-up using HICP
country and item weights.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

SHOCK_COICOPS = ("CP045", "CP0722")
RETAINED_COICOPS = (
    "CP01",
    "CP02",
    "CP03",
    "CP045",
    "CP04_CORE",
    "CP05",
    "CP06",
    "CP0722",
    "CP07_CORE",
    "CP08",
    "CP09",
    "CP10",
    "CP11",
    "CP12",
    "CP13",
)
EA_GEO = "EA"
EPSILON = 1e-12


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class DashboardData:
    baselines: pd.DataFrame
    multipliers: pd.DataFrame
    history: pd.DataFrame
    weights: pd.DataFrame
    headline_history: pd.DataFrame
    ea_component_history: pd.DataFrame
    countries: list[str]
    geos: list[str]
    coicops: list[str]
    origin: pd.Timestamp
    target_period: pd.Timestamp
    weight_year: int
    baseline_wide: pd.DataFrame
    lag0_wide: pd.DataFrame
    beta_sum_wide: pd.DataFrame
    item_weights_wide: pd.DataFrame
    item_norm_wide: pd.DataFrame
    country_weights: pd.Series
    country_norm: pd.Series


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AggregationResult:
    country_headlines: pd.DataFrame
    ea_headline: dict[str, float]
    country_components: pd.DataFrame
    ea_components: pd.DataFrame
    ea_countries: pd.DataFrame


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class GraphSeries:
    code: str
    history: pd.DataFrame
    origin_index: float
    baseline: float
    scenario: float
    is_source: bool
    shock_percent: float | None


def load_dashboard_data(data_dir: str | Path) -> DashboardData:
    data_dir = Path(data_dir)
    baselines = pd.read_csv(
        data_dir / "baselines.csv",
        parse_dates=["forecast_origin", "target_period"],
    )
    multipliers = pd.read_csv(data_dir / "multipliers.csv")
    history = pd.read_csv(data_dir / "historical_indices.csv", parse_dates=["date"])
    weights = pd.read_csv(data_dir / "weights.csv")
    headline_history = pd.read_csv(
        data_dir / "headline_history.csv", parse_dates=["date"]
    )
    ea_component_history = pd.read_csv(
        data_dir / "ea_component_history.csv", parse_dates=["date"]
    )

    _validate_frames(
        baselines,
        multipliers,
        history,
        weights,
        headline_history,
        ea_component_history,
    )

    countries = sorted(baselines["country"].unique())
    geos = [EA_GEO, *countries]
    coicops = [code for code in RETAINED_COICOPS if code in set(baselines["coicop"])]
    target_period = pd.Timestamp(baselines["target_period"].iloc[0])
    origin = pd.Timestamp(baselines["forecast_origin"].iloc[0])
    weight_year = int(weights["weight_year"].iloc[0])

    baseline_wide = (
        baselines.pivot(
            index="country", columns="coicop", values="baseline_index_t3"
        )
        .reindex(index=countries, columns=coicops)
        .astype(float)
    )
    lag0_wide = (
        baselines.pivot(
            index="country", columns="coicop", values="lag0_coefficient"
        )
        .reindex(index=countries, columns=coicops)
        .astype(float)
    )

    beta_045 = (
        multipliers[multipliers["shock_variable"] == "CP045"]
        .pivot(
            index="country",
            columns="target_coicop",
            values="beta_multiplier",
        )
        .reindex(index=countries, columns=coicops)
        .astype(float)
    )
    beta_0722 = (
        multipliers[multipliers["shock_variable"] == "CP0722"]
        .pivot(
            index="country",
            columns="target_coicop",
            values="beta_multiplier",
        )
        .reindex(index=countries, columns=coicops)
        .astype(float)
    )
    beta_sum_wide = beta_045.add(beta_0722, fill_value=0.0)

    item_weights_wide = (
        weights.pivot(index="country", columns="coicop", values="item_weight")
        .reindex(index=countries, columns=coicops)
        .astype(float)
    )
    item_norm_wide = item_weights_wide.div(
        item_weights_wide.sum(axis=1), axis=0
    )
    country_weights = (
        weights.groupby("country")["country_weight"]
        .first()
        .reindex(countries)
        .astype(float)
    )
    country_norm = country_weights / country_weights.sum()

    return DashboardData(
        baselines=baselines,
        multipliers=multipliers,
        history=history,
        weights=weights,
        headline_history=headline_history,
        ea_component_history=ea_component_history,
        countries=countries,
        geos=geos,
        coicops=coicops,
        origin=origin,
        target_period=target_period,
        weight_year=weight_year,
        baseline_wide=baseline_wide,
        lag0_wide=lag0_wide,
        beta_sum_wide=beta_sum_wide,
        item_weights_wide=item_weights_wide,
        item_norm_wide=item_norm_wide,
        country_weights=country_weights,
        country_norm=country_norm,
    )


def _validate_frames(
    baselines: pd.DataFrame,
    multipliers: pd.DataFrame,
    history: pd.DataFrame,
    weights: pd.DataFrame,
    headline_history: pd.DataFrame,
    ea_component_history: pd.DataFrame,
) -> None:
    if baselines.empty:
        raise ValueError("Empty baselines")
    if baselines["target_period"].nunique() != 1:
        raise ValueError("Expected exactly one target period")
    if baselines["forecast_origin"].nunique() != 1:
        raise ValueError("Expected exactly one forecast origin")
    expected_origin = pd.Timestamp(
        baselines["target_period"].iloc[0]
    ) - pd.DateOffset(months=3)
    if pd.Timestamp(baselines["forecast_origin"].iloc[0]) != expected_origin:
        raise ValueError("Forecast origin is not target period minus 3 months")
    if baselines.duplicated(["country", "coicop"]).any():
        raise ValueError("Duplicate baseline keys")
    if not np.isfinite(
        baselines[["baseline_index_t3", "lag0_coefficient"]]
    ).all().all():
        raise ValueError("Non-finite baseline values")

    if multipliers.duplicated(
        ["country", "target_coicop", "shock_variable"]
    ).any():
        raise ValueError("Duplicate multiplier keys")
    if not np.isfinite(multipliers["beta_multiplier"]).all():
        raise ValueError("Non-finite multipliers")

    if history.duplicated(["country", "coicop", "date"]).any():
        raise ValueError("Duplicate history keys")
    if not np.isfinite(history["index_value"]).all():
        raise ValueError("Non-finite history values")
    if history["date"].max() != pd.Timestamp(
        baselines["forecast_origin"].iloc[0]
    ):
        raise ValueError("History does not end at the forecast origin")

    if weights.duplicated(["country", "coicop"]).any():
        raise ValueError("Duplicate weight keys")
    if not np.isfinite(
        weights[["item_weight", "country_weight"]]
    ).all().all():
        raise ValueError("Non-finite weights")
    if (weights[["item_weight", "country_weight"]] <= 0).any().any():
        raise ValueError("Weights must be positive")
    if weights["country"].nunique() != 21:
        raise ValueError("Expected 21 countries in weights")
    if weights["coicop"].nunique() != len(RETAINED_COICOPS):
        raise ValueError("Expected 15 components in weights")

    if headline_history.duplicated(["country", "date"]).any():
        raise ValueError("Duplicate headline history keys")
    if not np.isfinite(headline_history["index_value"]).all():
        raise ValueError("Non-finite headline history values")
    if EA_GEO not in set(headline_history["country"]):
        raise ValueError("Headline history is missing EA")

    if ea_component_history.duplicated(["coicop", "date"]).any():
        raise ValueError("Duplicate EA component history keys")
    if not np.isfinite(ea_component_history["index_value"]).all():
        raise ValueError("Non-finite EA component history values")


def percent_to_log_shock(percent: float) -> float:
    """Convert an origin-index percent change to its YoY log change.

    The result is also the induced change in the 1-month YoY change at the
    forecast origin.
    """
    if not np.isfinite(percent) or percent <= -100.0:
        raise ValueError("Shock percent must be finite and greater than -100")
    return float(np.log1p(percent / 100.0))


def scenario_components(
    data: DashboardData,
    shock_percent_by_country: dict[str, float],
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Apply origin-index shocks and return target component scenarios.

    The shock is applied to the latest origin index of CP045 and CP0722. Its
    log value is propagated to the target period with ``1 + dy0`` for the
    shock sources and with the sum of the two pass-through betas for targets.
    The extra unit for sources is the direct shift in the origin YoY rate
    that is carried into the reconstructed target-period YoY forecast.
    """
    percentages = np.array(
        [
            float(shock_percent_by_country.get(country, 0.0))
            for country in data.countries
        ],
        dtype=float,
    )
    if not np.isfinite(percentages).all():
        raise ValueError("Shock percentages must be finite")
    if (percentages <= -100.0).any():
        raise ValueError("Shock percentages must be greater than -100")

    log_shocks = np.log1p(percentages / 100.0)[:, None]
    baseline = data.baseline_wide.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    beta_sum = data.beta_sum_wide.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    dy0 = data.lag0_wide.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    delta_log = log_shocks * beta_sum

    for index, coicop in enumerate(data.coicops):
        if coicop in SHOCK_COICOPS:
            delta_log[:, index] = log_shocks[:, 0] * (1.0 + dy0[:, index])

    scenario = baseline * np.exp(delta_log)

    origin_wide = (
        data.history[data.history["date"] == data.origin]
        .pivot(index="country", columns="coicop", values="index_value")
        .reindex(index=data.countries, columns=data.coicops)
        .astype(float)
    )
    origin_index = origin_wide.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    shocked_origin = origin_index.copy()
    for index, coicop in enumerate(data.coicops):
        if coicop in SHOCK_COICOPS:
            shocked_origin[:, index] = (
                origin_index[:, index] * (1.0 + percentages / 100.0)
            )

    rows = []
    for country_index, country in enumerate(data.countries):
        for component_index, coicop in enumerate(data.coicops):
            base_value = float(baseline[country_index, component_index])
            scenario_value = float(scenario[country_index, component_index])
            rows.append(
                {
                    "country": country,
                    "coicop": coicop,
                    "baseline_index": base_value,
                    "scenario_index": scenario_value,
                    "delta_log": float(
                        delta_log[country_index, component_index]
                    ),
                    "scenario_pct": 100.0
                    * float(
                        np.expm1(delta_log[country_index, component_index])
                    ),
                    "origin_index": float(
                        origin_index[country_index, component_index]
                    ),
                    "shocked_origin_index": float(
                        shocked_origin[country_index, component_index]
                    ),
                    "is_source": coicop in SHOCK_COICOPS,
                    "shock_percent": float(percentages[country_index]),
                }
            )
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def aggregate_scenarios(
    data: DashboardData,
    scenario: pd.DataFrame,
) -> AggregationResult:
    """Aggregate components to country and EA headline measures."""
    scenario_wide = (
        scenario.pivot(
            index="country", columns="coicop", values="scenario_index"
        )
        .reindex(index=data.countries, columns=data.coicops)
        .astype(float)
    )
    baseline = data.baseline_wide
    item_weights = data.item_norm_wide
    country_weights = data.country_norm

    country_baseline = (item_weights * baseline).sum(axis=1)
    country_scenario = (item_weights * scenario_wide).sum(axis=1)
    country_delta = country_scenario - country_baseline
    country_headlines = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "country": data.countries,
            "baseline": country_baseline.to_numpy(dtype=float),
            "scenario": country_scenario.to_numpy(dtype=float),
            "delta": country_delta.to_numpy(dtype=float),
            "pct_change": (
                100.0 * (country_scenario / country_baseline - 1.0)
            ).to_numpy(dtype=float),
        }
    ).set_index("country")

    country_component_delta = item_weights * (scenario_wide - baseline)
    country_components = country_component_delta.rename_axis(
        index="country", columns="coicop"
    ).stack().rename("contribution").reset_index()
    country_components = country_components.merge(
        baseline.rename_axis(index="country", columns="coicop")
        .stack()
        .rename("baseline")
        .reset_index(),
        on=["country", "coicop"],
        how="left",
    ).merge(
        scenario_wide.rename_axis(index="country", columns="coicop")
        .stack()
        .rename("scenario")
        .reset_index(),
        on=["country", "coicop"],
        how="left",
    )
    country_components["delta"] = (
        country_components["scenario"] - country_components["baseline"]
    )

    combined_weights = item_weights.mul(country_weights, axis=0)
    ea_item_weight = combined_weights.sum(axis=0)
    ea_baseline_numerator = (combined_weights * baseline).sum(axis=0)
    ea_scenario_numerator = (combined_weights * scenario_wide).sum(axis=0)
    ea_component_baseline = ea_baseline_numerator / ea_item_weight
    ea_component_scenario = ea_scenario_numerator / ea_item_weight
    ea_component_delta = ea_component_scenario - ea_component_baseline
    ea_component_contribution = ea_item_weight * ea_component_delta
    ea_components = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "coicop": data.coicops,
            "baseline": ea_component_baseline.to_numpy(dtype=float),
            "scenario": ea_component_scenario.to_numpy(dtype=float),
            "delta": ea_component_delta.to_numpy(dtype=float),
            "contribution": ea_component_contribution.to_numpy(dtype=float),
        }
    )

    ea_country_contribution = (
        country_weights * country_delta
    ).rename("contribution")
    ea_countries = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "country": data.countries,
            "baseline": country_baseline.to_numpy(dtype=float),
            "scenario": country_scenario.to_numpy(dtype=float),
            "delta": country_delta.to_numpy(dtype=float),
            "contribution": ea_country_contribution.to_numpy(dtype=float),
        }
    )

    ea_baseline = float((country_weights * country_baseline).sum())
    ea_scenario = float((country_weights * country_scenario).sum())
    ea_headline = {
        "baseline": ea_baseline,
        "scenario": ea_scenario,
        "delta": ea_scenario - ea_baseline,
        "pct_change": 100.0 * (ea_scenario / ea_baseline - 1.0),
    }

    return AggregationResult(
        country_headlines=country_headlines,
        ea_headline=ea_headline,
        country_components=country_components,
        ea_components=ea_components,
        ea_countries=ea_countries,
    )


def _add_shares(frame: pd.DataFrame, total: float) -> pd.DataFrame:
    result = frame.copy()
    gross = result["contribution"].abs().sum()
    if abs(total) > EPSILON:
        result["share_net"] = result["contribution"] / total
    else:
        result["share_net"] = 0.0
    if gross > EPSILON:
        result["share_gross"] = result["contribution"].abs() / gross
    else:
        result["share_gross"] = 0.0
    return result


def selected_headline(
    aggregation: AggregationResult, geo: str
) -> dict[str, float]:
    if geo == EA_GEO:
        return dict(aggregation.ea_headline)
    row = aggregation.country_headlines.loc[geo]
    return {
        "baseline": float(row["baseline"]),
        "scenario": float(row["scenario"]),
        "delta": float(row["delta"]),
        "pct_change": float(row["pct_change"]),
    }


def selected_component_contributions(
    aggregation: AggregationResult, geo: str
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if geo == EA_GEO:
        frame = aggregation.ea_components.copy()
    else:
        frame = aggregation.country_components[
            aggregation.country_components["country"] == geo
        ].copy()
    total = selected_headline(aggregation, geo)["delta"]
    return _add_shares(frame, total)


def selected_country_contributions(
    aggregation: AggregationResult, geo: str
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if geo == EA_GEO:
        frame = aggregation.ea_countries.copy()
        total = aggregation.ea_headline["delta"]
    else:
        row = aggregation.country_headlines.loc[geo]
        frame = pd.DataFrame(
            [
                {
                    "country": geo,
                    "baseline": float(row["baseline"]),
                    "scenario": float(row["scenario"]),
                    "delta": float(row["delta"]),
                    "contribution": float(row["delta"]),
                }
            ]
        )
        total = float(row["delta"])
    return _add_shares(frame, total)


def headline_history(
    data: DashboardData, geo: str
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    frame = data.headline_history[
        data.headline_history["country"] == geo
    ].sort_values("date")
    return frame[["date", "index_value"]].reset_index(drop=True)


def component_history(
    data: DashboardData, geo: str
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if geo == EA_GEO:
        source = data.ea_component_history
    else:
        source = data.history[data.history["country"] == geo]
    return (
        source.pivot(index="date", columns="coicop", values="index_value")
        .reindex(columns=data.coicops)
        .sort_index()
    )


def component_levels(
    aggregation: AggregationResult, geo: str
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if geo == EA_GEO:
        frame = aggregation.ea_components.copy()
    else:
        frame = aggregation.country_components[
            aggregation.country_components["country"] == geo
        ].copy()
    return frame.set_index("coicop")[["baseline", "scenario", "delta"]]


def selected_graph_series(
    data: DashboardData,
    aggregation: AggregationResult,
    geo: str,
    series: str,
    shock_percent: float | None = None,
) -> GraphSeries:
    """Return the history and target levels for one graph series."""
    if series == "HEADLINE":
        history = headline_history(data, geo)
        levels = selected_headline(aggregation, geo)
    else:
        if series not in data.coicops:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown graph series: {series}")
        history = (
            component_history(data, geo)[series]
            .dropna()
            .rename("index_value")
            .reset_index()
        )
        row = component_levels(aggregation, geo).loc[series]
        levels = {
            "baseline": float(row["baseline"]),
            "scenario": float(row["scenario"]),
        }

    origin_rows = history.loc[history["date"] == data.origin, "index_value"]
    if origin_rows.empty:
        raise ValueError(f"No origin observation for {geo}/{series}")
    return GraphSeries(
        code=series,
        history=history[["date", "index_value"]].reset_index(drop=True),
        origin_index=float(origin_rows.iloc[0]),
        baseline=float(levels["baseline"]),
        scenario=float(levels["scenario"]),
        is_source=series in SHOCK_COICOPS,
        shock_percent=shock_percent,
    )
